<!DOCTYPE html><html><head><meta charset="utf-8"><meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width,initial-scale=1"><title>Moonbound — A little leap into the night</title><style>
:root{color-scheme:dark;--ink:#e8f0e9;--quiet:#9ab4bc;--mint:#b9dec4;--gold:#ffcf77;--line:rgba(195,223,219,.22);--glass:rgba(7,24,32,.66)}
html,body{margin:0;padding:0;min-height:100%;box-sizing:border-box;background:#0c0c10;color:#ececf0;font-family:ui-sans-serif,system-ui}
*{box-sizing:inherit}body{overflow:hidden;width:100vw;height:100vh;height:100dvh;user-select:none;-webkit-user-select:none;overscroll-behavior:none}button{font:inherit;color:inherit;cursor:pointer;-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}button:focus-visible,canvas:focus-visible{outline:2px svg{pointer-events:none}svg{display:block}button{touch-action:manipulation}#world{position:fixed;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;display:block;background:#0b2430;touch-action:none;outline:none}.shade{position:fixed;inset:0;pointer-events:none;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(4,16,24,.36),transparent 26%,transparent 75%,rgba(3,14,21,.5))}.hud{position:fixed;left:30px;right:30px;top:25px;display:flex;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;pointer-events:none}.brand{display:flex;gap:15px;align-items:center}.brand-mark{width:35px;height:40px;filter:drop-shadow(0 0 11px #d9f0cf44);color:#edf0d4}.brand h1{font-size:21px;line-height:1.2;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:5px;margin:0 0 7px;color:#f3f4ed}.brand p{font-size:10px;letter-spacing:2.2px;color:#a3b9c1;margin:0}.actions{display:flex;gap:12px;align-items:center;pointer-events:auto}.coins{height:40px;min-width:108px;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:12px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;background:var(--glass);backdrop-filter:blur(12px);font-size:13px;font-weight:500;letter-spacing:1.3px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.coin-icon{width:18px;height:18px;border-radius:50%;background:#ffd57e;box-shadow:0 0 12px #ffbc5038,inset 0 0 0 2px #ffedb0,inset 0 0 0 4px #e7ad51;position:relative}.coin-icon:after{content:"";position:absolute;left:8px;top:5px;width:2px;height:8px;background:#fff0b7;border-radius:1px}.coin-total{color:#a5b3b7}.reset{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:9px;height:40px;padding:0 16px;border:1px solid #a2bbb9;border-radius:12px;background:rgba(9,28,37,.46);font-size:12px;letter-spacing:1px;transition:background .18s,border-color .18s}.reset svg{width:18px;height:18px}.reset:hover{background:#24414b;border-color:#e0ece0}.footer{position:fixed;bottom:24px;left:30px;right:30px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;pointer-events:none;color:#a8bdc3;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:1px}.keys{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}.keys kbd{font:11px ui-sans-serif,system-ui;color:#e6eeeb;border:1px solid #6e898e;border-bottom-width:2px;border-radius:5px;min-width:26px;height:27px;padding:4px 7px;text-align:center;background:#071b2480}.keys .jump-key{min-width:64px}.keys .key-label{margin-right:13px}.pause{pointer-events:auto;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(9,28,37,.6);border:1px solid var(--line);border-radius:8px;width:31px;height:29px;color:#b8cccc;margin-left:4px;transition:background .18s}.pause:hover{background:#294650}.pause svg{width:13px;height:13px}.route{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}.route-line{width:110px;height:2px;background:#aec9c333;position:relative}.route-fill{position:absolute;inset:0 auto 0 0;width:0;background:#b9dec4;transition:width .2s}.route-fill:after{content:"";position:absolute;right:-2px;top:-2px;width:5px;height:5px;border-radius:50%;background:#d2efd6;box-shadow:0 0 7px #e8ffca55}.route svg{width:14px;height:17px;color:#d2dec8}.touch{display:none;position:fixed;left:18px;right:18px;bottom:22px;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;pointer-events:none}.touch-group{display:flex;gap:10px}.touch button{pointer-events:auto;width:55px;height:52px;border-radius:15px;border:1px solid #b5d7d34a;background:rgba(11,32,41,.66);color:#d2e3de;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;touch-action:none;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}.touch button svg{width:22px;height:22px}.touch button.held{background:rgba(106,151,138,.48);border-color:#bbd9bb}.touch #jump{width:66px;height:59px;background:rgba(161,200,170,.14);flex-direction:column;gap:3px}.touch #jump span{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1.4px}.touch-pause{align-self:center!important;width:35px!important;height:35px!important;border-radius:50%!important}.touch-pause svg{width:12px!important;height:12px!important}#toast{position:fixed;top:90px;left:50%;transform:translate(-50%,-8px);color:#d7e9d8;background:#0b2433bd;border:1px solid #accdb52b;border-radius:20px;padding:9px 17px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.7px;white-space:nowrap;opacity:0;transition:opacity .25s,transform .25s;pointer-events:none}#toast.shown{opacity:1;transform:translate(-50%,0)}.overlay{position:fixed;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:20px;background:rgba(5,17,24,.56);backdrop-filter:blur(5px)}.overlay[hidden]{display:none}.end-card{width:min(380px,100%);text-align:center;padding:31px 30px 28px;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#183c46f2,#0b222cf5);border:1px solid #aacdb44a;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 25px 100px #0006}.end-icon{width:44px;height:48px;margin:0 auto 18px;color:#e6eacc}.end-card h2{font:500 28px/1.2 Georgia,serif;color:#f1f0dd;margin:0 0 12px}.end-card p{font-size:13px;line-height:1.8;color:#b6ccd0;margin:0 0 20px}.end-card button{width:100%;border:1px solid #d3e2ba;border-radius:10px;background:#cdddb9;color:#20372f;padding:13px 18px;font-size:12px;font-weight:650;letter-spacing:1px;transition:background .15s}.end-card button:hover{background:#e0e9c8}.end-card .secondary{background:transparent;border-color:var(--line);color:#bfd0ce;margin-top:9px}.end-card .secondary:hover{background:#26464d}.end-detail{font-size:10px!important;letter-spacing:.8px;margin-top:18px!important;margin-bottom:0!important;color:#9fbbc2!important}.sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}#error{position:fixed;left:20px;right:20px;bottom:20px;padding:16px;background:#49252d;color:#fff4e9;border:1px solid #edb4a0;border-radius:10px;z-index:100;font-size:13px;user-select:text}#error[hidden]{display:none}
@media(max-width:700px),(pointer:coarse){.touch{display:flex}.footer{display:none}.hud{left:18px;right:18px;top:20px}.brand{gap:9px}.brand-mark{width:27px;height:32px}.brand h1{font-size:15px;letter-spacing:3px;margin:0 0 5px}.brand p{font-size:8px;letter-spacing:1.1px}.actions{gap:8px}.coins{height:36px;min-width:87px;padding:0 10px;gap:9px;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.7px}.coin-icon{width:16px;height:16px;flex-shrink:0}.coin-icon:after{left:7px;top:4px}.reset{width:36px;height:36px;border-radius:10px;padding:0}.reset span{display:none}#toast{top:76px;font-size:10px;padding:8px 13px}}
@media(max-width:410px){.hud{left:15px;right:15px;gap:8px}.brand-mark{width:23px}.brand h1{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:2.5px}.brand p{font-size:7px;letter-spacing:.7px}.coins{min-width:81px;padding:0 9px;gap:7px}.actions{gap:7px}.touch{left:15px;right:15px}.end-card{padding:25px 23px}}
@media(max-height:400px){.hud{top:13px}.brand p{display:none}.brand h1{margin:0}.touch{bottom:12px}.touch button{height:43px;width:48px}.touch #jump{height:48px;width:58px}.footer{bottom:14px}.end-card{padding:18px 25px}.end-icon{display:none}.end-card p{margin-bottom:12px}.end-detail{display:none}#toast{top:65px}}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*,*:before,*:after{transition:none!important}}
</style></head><body>
<canvas id="world" tabindex="0" aria-label="Moonbound platformer. Run with A and D or arrow keys. Hold Space, W, or Up to jump higher. Collect coins and reach the flag. R resets; P pauses." aria-describedby="instructions">Your browser needs Canvas to play Moonbound.</canvas>
<div class="shade" aria-hidden="true"></div>
<header class="hud"><div class="brand"><svg class="brand-mark" viewBox="0 0 40 44" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M29 3A18 18 0 1 0 37 33C16 40 9 14 29 3Z" fill="currentColor"/></svg><div><h1>MOONBOUND</h1><p>A little leap into the night.</p></div></div><div class="actions"><div class="coins" aria-label="Coins collected"><i class="coin-icon" aria-hidden="true"></i><span><span id="coinCount">00</span><span class="coin-total"> / 18</span></span></div><button class="reset" id="reset" aria-label="Reset game" title="Reset game (R)"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.7" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M4 10a8 8 0 1 1 .5 6M4 4v6h6"/></svg><span>Reset</span></button></div></header>
<footer class="footer"><div class="keys" id="instructions"><kbd>A</kbd><kbd>D</kbd><span class="key-label">move</span><kbd class="jump-key">Space</kbd><span class="key-label">jump</span><button class="pause" id="pause" title="Pause (P or Escape)" aria-label="Pause game"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3" y="2" width="3" height="12" rx="1" fill="currentColor"/><rect x="10" y="2" width="3" height="12" rx="1" fill="currentColor"/></svg></button></div><div class="route"><span>Reach the flag.</span><div class="route-line" role="progressbar" aria-label="Journey progress" aria-valuemin="0" aria-valuemax="100" aria-valuenow="0" id="progress"><div class="route-fill" id="routeFill"></div></div><svg viewBox="0 0 16 20" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.4" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M3 19V2m0 1c5-4 6 4 11 0v8c-5 4-6-4-11 0"/></svg></div></footer>
<div class="touch" aria-label="Touch controls"><div class="touch-group"><button id="left" aria-label="Move left"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m14 5-7 7 7 7"/></svg></button><button id="right" aria-label="Move right"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m10 5 7 7-7 7"/></svg></button></div><button class="touch-pause" id="touchPause" aria-label="Pause game"><svg viewBox="0 0 16 16" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3" y="2" width="3" height="12" rx="1" fill="currentColor"/><rect x="10" y="2" width="3" height="12" rx="1" fill="currentColor"/></svg></button><button id="jump" aria-label="Jump; hold for a higher jump"><svg viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="1.8" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 20V4m-7 7 7-7 7 7"/></svg><span>JUMP</span></button></div>
<div id="toast" role="status" aria-live="polite"></div><div id="announcement" class="sr-only" aria-live="polite"></div>
<section id="finish" class="overlay" hidden role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="finishTitle"><div class="end-card"><svg class="end-icon" viewBox="0 0 40 44" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M29 3A18 18 0 1 0 37 33C16 40 9 14 29 3Z" fill="currentColor"/></svg><h2 id="finishTitle">You found your way.</h2><p id="finishText"></p><button id="replay">One more journey</button><p class="end-detail" id="finishDetail"></p></div></section>
<section id="pauseScreen" class="overlay" hidden role="dialog" aria-modal="true" aria-labelledby="pauseTitle"><div class="end-card"><h2 id="pauseTitle">A moment of quiet.</h2><p>Your little adventure will be right here.</p><button id="resume">Keep exploring</button><button class="secondary" id="pauseReset">Start again</button><p class="end-detail">Hold jump for a higher leap.</p></div></section>
<div id="error" role="alert" hidden></div>
<script>
try {
'use strict';
/* Moonbound: one offline document. Visual system: petrol night, pale mint moss,
   warm gold lights, open full-bleed landscape, compact system-font controls.
   Concept fidelity: crescent brand and tracked title at upper left; coin/reset
   controls at upper right; original petrol/mint/gold palette and generated
   landscape retained; responsive HUD becomes compact on mobile. Terrain uses
   the matching embedded moss-island sprite. Intentional game adaptations:
   longer scrolling route, checkpoints, touch controls, pause and victory states.
   Browser screenshot comparison was blocked by environment URL policy.
   Generated landscape and terrain are embedded below; player, flag, foliage,
   and particles are intentionally Canvas-native for responsive animation. */
const canvas = document.getElementById('world');
const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d', {alpha:false});
if (!ctx) throw new Error('Canvas is not supported in this browser.');
const $ = id => document.getElementById(id);
const TAU = Math.PI * 2;
const clamp = (v,a,b) => Math.max(a,Math.min(b,v));
const lerp = (a,b,t) => a+(b-a)*t;
const hash = n => {const v=Math.sin(n*127.1+311.7)*43758.5453;return v-Math.floor(v);};
const reducedMotion = window.matchMedia && window.matchMedia('(prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)').matches;
let width=innerWidth,height=innerHeight,dpr=1,scale=1,viewWidth=1200;
let camera=0,clock=0,lastTime=0,accumulator=0,raf=0,elapsed=0;
let started=false,won=false,paused=false,destroyed=false,collected=0,falls=0;
let toastTime=0,jumpBuffer=0,coyote=0,respawnTime=0,lastProgress=-1;
let respawn={x:132,y:450},checkpointIndex=0;
const keySet=new Set(),pointerActions=new Map();
const player={x:132,y:412,w:24,h:38,vx:0,vy:0,facing:1,grounded:true,step:0,squash:0,trail:[]};
const platforms=[
 {x:-120,y:450,w:555,depth:180},
 {x:520,y:400,w:230,depth:148},
 {x:845,y:345,w:200,depth:167},
 {x:1125,y:425,w:325,depth:190,checkpoint:true},
 {x:1535,y:365,w:205,depth:148},
 {x:1830,y:425,w:235,depth:190},
 {x:2150,y:345,w:195,depth:158},
 {x:2435,y:395,w:260,depth:170,checkpoint:true},
 {x:2780,y:330,w:220,depth:160},
 {x:3090,y:405,w:405,depth:212}
];
const coinPositions=[[280,409],[360,409],[484,328],[580,359],[680,359],[804,270],[940,304],[1100,227],[1300,384],[1490,299],[1640,324],[1790,243],[1940,384],[2110,280],[2250,304],[2580,354],[2890,289],[3250,364]];
const coins=coinPositions.map((p,i)=>({x:p[0],y:p[1],phase:i*1.79,taken:false}));
const particles=[];
const goal={x:3370,y:405};
const landscape=new Image(),island=new Image();
landscape.src='data:image/webp;base64,';
island.src='data:image/webp;base64,';
const islandCrop={x:28,y:60,w:2118,h:610,ledge:.24};
const stars=Array.from({length:90},(_,i)=>({x:hash(i+12),y:hash(i+721)*.68,r:hash(i+384)*1.1+.35,a:hash(i+49)*.45+.16}));
function poly(points,fill){ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(points[0][0],points[0][1]);for(let i=1;i<points.length;i++)ctx.lineTo(points[i][0],points[i][1]);ctx.closePath();ctx.fillStyle=fill;ctx.fill();}
function ellipse(x,y,rx,ry,fill){ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(x,y,Math.max(.01,rx),Math.max(.01,ry),0,0,TAU);ctx.fillStyle=fill;ctx.fill();}
function roundRect(x,y,w,h,r,fill){ctx.beginPath();ctx.roundRect(x,y,w,h,r);ctx.fillStyle=fill;ctx.fill();}
function notify(message,duration=2.6){$('toast').textContent=message;$('toast').classList.add('shown');toastTime=duration;}
function announce(message){$('announcement').textContent=message;}
function fail(error){cancelAnimationFrame(raf);destroyed=true;const panel=$('error');panel.hidden=false;panel.textContent='Moonbound could not continue: '+(error&&error.message?error.message:String(error));}
function resize(){
 width=Math.max(1,window.innerWidth);height=Math.max(1,window.innerHeight);dpr=Math.min(window.devicePixelRatio||1,2);
 canvas.width=Math.round(width*dpr);canvas.height=Math.round(height*dpr);
 scale=height/600;viewWidth=width/scale;
 camera=clamp(player.x-viewWidth*.28,0,Math.max(0,3540-viewWidth));
 render();
}
function isDown(action){
 if([...pointerActions.values()].includes(action))return true;
 if(action==='left')return keySet.has('ArrowLeft')||keySet.has('KeyA');
 if(action==='right')return keySet.has('ArrowRight')||keySet.has('KeyD');
 return keySet.has('Space')||keySet.has('ArrowUp')||keySet.has('KeyW');
}
function clearInput(){keySet.clear();pointerActions.clear();jumpBuffer=0;document.querySelectorAll('.held').forEach(b=>b.classList.remove('held'));}
function focusGame(){canvas.focus({preventScroll:true});}
function setSceneInert(value){document.querySelector('.hud').inert=value;document.querySelector('.footer').inert=value;document.querySelector('.touch').inert=value;canvas.inert=value;}
function reset(){
 coins.forEach(c=>c.taken=false);particles.length=0;collected=0;falls=0;elapsed=0;clock=0;started=false;won=false;paused=false;camera=0;checkpointIndex=0;
 respawn={x:132,y:450};Object.assign(player,{x:132,y:412,vx:0,vy:0,facing:1,grounded:true,step:0,squash:0,trail:[]});
 coyote=.12;respawnTime=0;toastTime=0;clearInput();lastProgress=-1;
 $('coinCount').textContent='00';$('finish').hidden=true;$('pauseScreen').hidden=true;$('toast').classList.remove('shown');
 setSceneInert(false);lastTime=performance.now();accumulator=0;focusGame();updateProgress();render();
}
function togglePause(force){
 if(won)return;
 paused=typeof force==='boolean'?force:!paused;clearInput();$('pauseScreen').hidden=!paused;setSceneInert(paused);
 if(paused)$('resume').focus();else{lastTime=performance.now();accumulator=0;focusGame();}
}
function burst(x,y,count,color,speed=100){
 for(let i=0;i<count;i++){const angle=Math.random()*TAU,v=speed*(.25+Math.random()*.75);particles.push({x,y,vx:Math.cos(angle)*v,vy:Math.sin(angle)*v-30,life:.5+Math.random()*.5,max:1,color,size:1+Math.random()*2});}
}
function die(){
 if(respawnTime)return;
 falls++;respawnTime=.46;player.vx=0;clearInput();notify(checkpointIndex?'Back to your lantern. Try another leap.':'A little higher. Hold jump for a longer leap.',2.7);
}
function complete(){
 if(won)return;
 won=true;clearInput();player.vx=0;
 burst(goal.x+25,goal.y-90,65,'#ffdc8f',170);burst(goal.x,goal.y-65,35,'#bddfca',130);
 $('finishText').textContent=collected===coins.length?'Every little light, brought home.':collected+' of '+coins.length+' little lights, brought home.';
 const seconds=Math.floor(elapsed);$('finishDetail').textContent=Math.floor(seconds/60)+':'+String(seconds%60).padStart(2,'0')+' on the trail · '+(falls===0?'A flawless crossing':falls+' fresh '+(falls===1?'start':'starts'));
 $('finish').hidden=false;setSceneInert(true);$('replay').focus();announce('Journey complete! '+collected+' of 18 coins collected.');
}
function updateProgress(){const p=won?100:Math.round(clamp((player.x-132)/(goal.x-132),0,1)*100);if(p!==lastProgress){$('routeFill').style.width=p+'%';$('progress').setAttribute('aria-valuenow',String(p));lastProgress=p;}}
function update(dt){
 if(paused)return;
 clock+=dt;if(toastTime>0){toastTime-=dt;if(toastTime<=0)$('toast').classList.remove('shown');}
 for(let i=particles.length-1;i>=0;i--){const p=particles[i];p.life-=dt;p.x+=p.vx*dt;p.y+=p.vy*dt;p.vy+=180*dt;if(p.life<=0)particles.splice(i,1);}
 player.squash=Math.max(0,player.squash-dt*5);
 if(won)return;
 if(respawnTime>0){respawnTime-=dt;if(respawnTime<=0){player.x=respawn.x;player.y=respawn.y-player.h;player.vx=0;player.vy=0;player.grounded=true;player.trail=[];camera=clamp(player.x-viewWidth*.28,0,Math.max(0,3540-viewWidth));burst(player.x+12,player.y+30,12,'#b5dac4',70);}return;}
 const move=Number(isDown('right'))-Number(isDown('left'));
 if(move||jumpBuffer>0)started=true;
 if(started)elapsed+=dt;
 const accel=player.grounded?2200:1450,target=move*300;
 player.vx+=clamp(target-player.vx,-accel*dt,accel*dt);
 if(move)player.facing=move;
 player.step+=Math.abs(player.vx)*dt*.045;
 if(player.grounded)coyote=.115;else coyote-=dt;
 if(jumpBuffer>0)jumpBuffer-=dt;
 if(jumpBuffer>0&&coyote>0){player.vy=-600;player.grounded=false;coyote=0;jumpBuffer=0;player.squash=.24;burst(player.x+12,player.y+player.h,7,'#a9c7b1',48);}
 const oldBottom=player.y+player.h;
 player.vy=Math.min(player.vy+1480*dt,900);
 player.x=clamp(player.x+player.vx*dt,4,3520-player.w);
 player.y+=player.vy*dt;player.grounded=false;
 if(player.vy>=0){
  for(let i=0;i<platforms.length;i++){
   const p=platforms[i];
   if(player.x+player.w>p.x+3&&player.x<p.x+p.w-3&&oldBottom<=p.y+1&&player.y+player.h>=p.y){
    if(player.vy>210){player.squash=.55;burst(player.x+12,p.y,6,'#8ba99c',45);}
    player.y=p.y-player.h;player.vy=0;player.grounded=true;
    if(p.checkpoint&&i>checkpointIndex){checkpointIndex=i;respawn={x:p.x+70,y:p.y};notify('Lantern lit. Your next leap starts here.');burst(p.x+54,p.y-36,20,'#ffe0a0',85);announce('Checkpoint reached.');}
    break;
   }
  }
 }
 for(const c of coins){
  if(c.taken)continue;
  const cy=c.y+Math.sin(clock*2.3+c.phase)*3;
  const nx=clamp(c.x,player.x,player.x+player.w),ny=clamp(cy,player.y,player.y+player.h);
  if((nx-c.x)**2+(ny-cy)**2<15**2){c.taken=true;collected++;$('coinCount').textContent=String(collected).padStart(2,'0');burst(c.x,cy,12,'#ffce75',90);announce(collected+' of 18 coins collected.');}
 }
 if(player.y>690)die();
 if(player.x+player.w>goal.x-12&&player.x<goal.x+65&&player.grounded&&Math.abs(player.y+player.h-goal.y)<5)complete();
 const desired=clamp(player.x-viewWidth*.28,0,Math.max(0,3540-viewWidth));
 camera=lerp(camera,desired,1-Math.exp(-dt*5));
 updateProgress();
}
function drawFallbackSky(){
 const sky=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,0,0,height);sky.addColorStop(0,'#081e2b');sky.addColorStop(.65,'#1c4859');sky.addColorStop(1,'#0b2430');ctx.fillStyle=sky;ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,height);
 const mx=width*.76-camera*.025*scale,my=height*.245,mr=height*.115;
 const aura=ctx.createRadialGradient(mx,my,mr*.4,mx,my,mr*2.6);aura.addColorStop(0,'#d3e9c01c');aura.addColorStop(1,'#d3e9c000');ctx.fillStyle=aura;ctx.fillRect(mx-mr*3,my-mr*3,mr*6,mr*6);
 ellipse(mx,my,mr,mr,'#cce3bd');ctx.save();ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(mx,my,mr,0,TAU);ctx.clip();for(let i=0;i<15;i++)ellipse(mx+(hash(i+48)-.5)*mr*2,my+(hash(i+15)-.5)*mr*2,10+hash(i+200)*mr*.3,8+hash(i+61)*mr*.2,'#9fc6b277');ctx.restore();
 for(let j=0;j<3;j++){const points=[[-20,height]];for(let x=-20;x<=width+40;x+=40){const wx=x+camera*(.08+j*.08)*scale;points.push([x,height*(.52+j*.13)-Math.sin(wx/(130-j*25))*height*.09-Math.sin(wx/55)*height*.035]);}points.push([width+40,height]);poly(points,['#1b3b4c','#143440','#102b34'][j]);}
}
function tree(x,y,h,color){
 ctx.strokeStyle=color;ctx.lineWidth=Math.max(1,h*.032);ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,y);ctx.lineTo(x,y-h);ctx.stroke();
 for(let i=0;i<5;i++){const t=i/5,yy=y-h+t*h*.67,ww=h*(.115+t*.125);poly([[x,yy],[x-ww,yy+h*.36],[x-ww*.15,yy+h*.28],[x+ww,yy+h*.36]],color);}
}
function drawBackground(){
 if(landscape.complete&&landscape.naturalWidth){
  const ratio=Math.max(width/landscape.naturalWidth,height/landscape.naturalHeight)*1.1;
  const iw=landscape.naturalWidth*ratio,ih=landscape.naturalHeight*ratio;
  const origin=clamp(width*.76-iw*.73,width-iw,0);
  const drift=clamp(origin-camera*scale*.018,width-iw,0);
  ctx.drawImage(landscape,drift,-(ih-height)*.33,iw,ih);
 }else drawFallbackSky();
 // These sparse stars and forest silhouettes sit at different camera depths.
 for(const s of stars){const sx=((s.x*width-camera*.025*scale)%width+width)%width;ctx.globalAlpha=s.a*(reducedMotion?1:(.75+.25*Math.sin(clock*.6+s.x*20)));ellipse(sx,s.y*height,s.r*.7,s.r*.7,'#d1e4db');}ctx.globalAlpha=1;
 ctx.save();ctx.scale(scale,scale);
 for(let layer=0;layer<2;layer++){
  const factor=layer===0?.16:.31,spacing=layer===0?79:120,offset=camera*factor;
  const start=Math.floor(offset/spacing)-2,end=Math.ceil((offset+viewWidth)/spacing)+2;
  for(let i=start;i<end;i++){const seed=i+100+layer*470,x=i*spacing-offset+hash(seed+19)*28,y=layer===0?534:573,h=55+hash(seed)*85;tree(x,y,h,layer===0?'#0c28333d':'#08212b70');}
 }
 ctx.restore();
}
function grass(x,y,n,seed,color){
 ctx.strokeStyle=color;ctx.lineWidth=1.2;ctx.lineCap='round';ctx.beginPath();for(let j=0;j<n;j++){const px=x+(hash(seed+j*2)-.5)*15,h=3+hash(seed+j*9)*10;ctx.moveTo(px,y);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(px-2,y-h*.6,px+(hash(seed+j*3)-.5)*12,y-h);}ctx.stroke();
}
function fallbackIsland(p,i){
 const x=p.x,y=p.y,w=p.w,d=p.depth;
 poly([[x,y+6],[x+w,y+6],[x+w-13,y+45],[x+w*.79,y+d*.62],[x+w*.48,y+d],[x+w*.23,y+d*.66],[x+15,y+55]],'#17313a');
 poly([[x+w*.08,y+14],[x+w*.48,y+35],[x+w*.34,y+d*.73],[x+w*.17,y+d*.49]],'#2b4850');
 poly([[x+w*.48,y+35],[x+w*.85,y+12],[x+w*.69,y+d*.62],[x+w*.48,y+d]],'#223d45');
 poly([[x+w*.85,y+12],[x+w-6,y+8],[x+w*.81,y+d*.59],[x+w*.62,y+d*.78]],'#36505a');
 const edge=[];for(let k=0;k<=w;k+=14)edge.push([x+k,y+7+hash(k+i*90)*15]);poly([[x,y],[x+w,y],...edge.reverse()],'#608775');
 roundRect(x-3,y-3,w+6,8,5,'#92b395');
}
function drawIsland(p,i){
 if(p.x-camera>viewWidth+100||p.x+p.w-camera< -100)return;
 if(island.complete&&island.naturalWidth){
  const c=islandCrop;
  ctx.drawImage(island,c.x,c.y,c.w,c.h,p.x-8,p.y-p.depth*c.ledge,p.w+16,p.depth);
 }else fallbackIsland(p,i);
 // A precise moss edge makes each playable landing surface unambiguous.
 ctx.strokeStyle='#aec8a1';ctx.lineWidth=2;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(p.x+8,p.y);for(let k=18;k<p.w-5;k+=10)ctx.lineTo(p.x+k,p.y+(hash(k+i*71)-.5)*2);ctx.stroke();
 for(let k=15;k<p.w-10;k+=27)grass(p.x+k,p.y-2,4,i*911+k,'#a4ba8d');
 for(let j=0;j<3;j++){
  const x=p.x+p.w*(.15+j*.32),len=21+hash(i*75+j)*40;
  ctx.strokeStyle='#426e61';ctx.lineWidth=1.4;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x,p.y+12);ctx.bezierCurveTo(x-8,p.y+25,x+7,p.y+len,x-2,p.y+len+15);ctx.stroke();
  for(let v=0;v<4;v++)ellipse(x+(v%2?3:-3),p.y+15+v*len/4,3,5,'#466f60');
 }
 // Small blue flowers share the islands' light without competing with coins.
 if(i%2===0){const fx=p.x+p.w*.72;ctx.strokeStyle='#698e83';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(fx,p.y);ctx.lineTo(fx-3,p.y-15);ctx.stroke();ellipse(fx-3,p.y-16,3,2,'#a4d1cc');}
 if(p.checkpoint)drawLantern(p.x+54,p.y,i<=checkpointIndex);
}
function drawLantern(x,y,lit){
 roundRect(x-3,y-34,6,34,2,'#698883');roundRect(x-8,y-39,16,3,1,'#78948a');roundRect(x-7,y-35,14,16,3,lit?'#edd399':'#526b69');
 if(lit){const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(x,y-29,2,x,y-29,52);g.addColorStop(0,'#ffd98335');g.addColorStop(1,'#ffd98300');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(x-52,y-81,104,104);ellipse(x,y-28,3,5,'#ffebb9');}
}
function drawCoins(){
 for(const c of coins){if(c.taken||c.x<camera-25||c.x>camera+viewWidth+25)continue;
  const y=c.y+(reducedMotion?0:Math.sin(clock*2.3+c.phase)*3),sx=reducedMotion?1:.82+.18*Math.cos(clock*2.7+c.phase);
  const g=ctx.createRadialGradient(c.x,y,2,c.x,y,24);g.addColorStop(0,'#ffcc6934');g.addColorStop(1,'#ffcc6900');ctx.fillStyle=g;ctx.fillRect(c.x-24,y-24,48,48);
  ctx.save();ctx.translate(c.x,y);ctx.scale(sx,1);ellipse(0,0,8,9,'#edaa4c');ellipse(0,-.5,6.5,7.5,'#ffe09a');ctx.strokeStyle='#d99b43';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.beginPath();ctx.ellipse(0,-.5,4.7,5.5,0,0,TAU);ctx.stroke();roundRect(-.8,-4,1.6,6.5,.8,'#fff3c7');ctx.restore();
 }
}
function drawFlag(){
 const x=goal.x,y=goal.y;
 ellipse(x,y+2,18,4,'#081c2444');roundRect(x-2,y-102,4,103,2,'#c5b18c');ellipse(x,y-103,3.5,3.5,'#eccea0');
 ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(x+2,y-98);ctx.bezierCurveTo(x+23,y-105,x+32,y-84+Math.sin(clock*3)*3,x+59,y-91);ctx.lineTo(x+51,y-77);ctx.lineTo(x+60,y-64);ctx.bezierCurveTo(x+32,y-59,x+22,y-83,x+2,y-70);
 ctx.closePath();ctx.fillStyle='#dfdfb3';ctx.fill();
 ctx.save();ctx.translate(x+25,y-82);ctx.rotate(.13);ctx.beginPath();ctx.arc(0,0,8,Math.PI*.31,Math.PI*1.7);ctx.bezierCurveTo(-1,-9,-6,1,5,7);ctx.fillStyle='#26454b';ctx.fill();ctx.restore();
}
function drawPlayer(){
 if(respawnTime>0)return;
 const p=player,cx=p.x+p.w/2,feet=p.y+p.h,bob=p.grounded?(Math.abs(p.vx)>15?Math.sin(p.step*2)*1.1:Math.sin(clock*2)*.6):0;
 if(p.grounded)ellipse(cx,feet+1,14,3,'#071d2966');
 ctx.save();ctx.translate(cx,feet+bob);ctx.scale(p.facing,1);ctx.rotate(p.vx/300*.045);
 const squish=p.squash*.16;ctx.scale(1+squish,1-squish);
 const walk=p.grounded?Math.sin(p.step)*3:2;
 // Articulated little boots, coat and hood are drawn around the collision body.
 roundRect(-8,-7+walk,5,8,2,'#c0dbc3');roundRect(3,-7-walk,5,8,2,'#9ebfad');
 poly([[-7,-25],[6,-25],[12,-8],[5,-5],[-12,-8]],'#c4ddc6');
 poly([[-7,-24],[-3,-22],[-3,-7],[-12,-8]],'#9fc8b6');
 ctx.strokeStyle='#e1eed1';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,-23);ctx.lineTo(0,-9);ctx.stroke();
 const wave=Math.sin(clock*9)*2+(p.grounded?0:3);
 ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-3,-26);ctx.bezierCurveTo(-15,-26,-21,-32+wave,-30,-28+wave);ctx.lineTo(-38,-30+wave);ctx.lineTo(-34,-24+wave);ctx.lineTo(-39,-21+wave);ctx.bezierCurveTo(-24,-21+wave,-16,-22,-3,-23);ctx.closePath();ctx.fillStyle='#e68868';ctx.fill();
 ellipse(0,-31,11,12,'#d9e7c8');
 ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(-9,-36);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(-8,-47,2,-44);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(9,-42,10,-32);ctx.closePath();ctx.fillStyle='#d9e7c8';ctx.fill();
 ellipse(5,-31,6.5,8,'#203e44');ellipse(4,-32,1,1.6,'#e6f3d0');ellipse(8,-32,1,1.6,'#e6f3d0');
 roundRect(-9,-25,17,4,2,'#ed9874');ctx.restore();
 if(!started){
  const alpha=reducedMotion?1:.8+.2*Math.sin(clock*1.7);
  ctx.globalAlpha=alpha;ctx.fillStyle='#e2e8db';ctx.font='12px ui-sans-serif, system-ui';ctx.textAlign='center';ctx.fillText('Follow the little lights.',cx+27,p.y-48);
  ctx.strokeStyle='#b7cfc3';ctx.lineWidth=1;ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(cx+16,p.y-34);ctx.lineTo(cx+38,p.y-34);ctx.stroke();ctx.globalAlpha=1;
 }
}
function drawMotes(){
 if(reducedMotion)return;
 for(let i=0;i<25;i++){
  const span=viewWidth+100,x=((hash(i+952)*span-camera*.46+Math.sin(clock*.24+i)*14)%span+span)%span-50;
  const y=410+hash(i+738)*156+Math.sin(clock*.8+i*3)*8;
  ctx.globalAlpha=(.12+.3*(.5+.5*Math.sin(clock*1.4+i)))*.8;ellipse(x,y,1.3,1.3,'#d4e6a4');
 }ctx.globalAlpha=1;
}
function fern(x,y,size,flip,seed){
 ctx.save();ctx.translate(x,y);ctx.scale(flip*size,size);ctx.strokeStyle='#041720';ctx.lineWidth=2;
 for(let b=0;b<4;b++){
  const endx=(b-1.5)*22,endy=-32-hash(seed+b)*43;
  ctx.beginPath();ctx.moveTo(0,0);ctx.quadraticCurveTo(endx*.2,endy*.6,endx,endy);ctx.stroke();
  for(let j=1;j<7;j++){const t=j/7,px=endx*t*t,py=endy*t,l=10*(1-t)+2;
   ctx.save();ctx.translate(px,py);ctx.rotate(endx*.009);ellipse(-l*.6,-2,l,2.6,'#041720');ellipse(l*.6,-5,l,2.6,'#041720');ctx.restore();
  }
 }ctx.restore();
}
function drawForeground(){
 const floor=ctx.createLinearGradient(0,520,0,600);floor.addColorStop(0,'#04192300');floor.addColorStop(1,'#04141dc9');ctx.fillStyle=floor;ctx.fillRect(0,520,viewWidth,80);
 const offset=camera*.55;
 for(let i=Math.floor(offset/240)-1;i<(offset+viewWidth)/240+1;i++){
  const x=i*240-offset;fern(x,618,.85+hash(i+55)*.6,hash(i+123)>.5?1:-1,i+876);
 }
}
function render(){
 ctx.setTransform(dpr,0,0,dpr,0,0);ctx.globalAlpha=1;drawBackground();
 ctx.save();ctx.scale(scale,scale);drawMotes();ctx.translate(-camera,0);
 for(let i=0;i<platforms.length;i++)drawIsland(platforms[i],i);
 drawFlag();drawCoins();drawPlayer();
 for(const p of particles){ctx.globalAlpha=clamp(p.life/p.max,0,1);ellipse(p.x,p.y,p.size,p.size,p.color);}ctx.globalAlpha=1;
 ctx.translate(camera,0);drawForeground();ctx.restore();
 if(respawnTime>0){ctx.fillStyle='rgba(6,22,31,'+(Math.sin(respawnTime/.46*Math.PI)*.32)+')';ctx.fillRect(0,0,width,height);}
}
function frame(time){
 if(destroyed)return;
 try{
  const dt=Math.min((time-lastTime)/1000,.06);lastTime=time;
  if(!document.hidden){accumulator+=dt;while(accumulator>=1/120){update(1/120);accumulator-=1/120;}render();}
  raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
 }catch(error){fail(error);}
}
const gameKeys=new Set(['ArrowLeft','ArrowRight','ArrowUp','KeyA','KeyD','KeyW','Space']);
window.addEventListener('keydown',event=>{
 if(event.code==='Tab'&&(! $('finish').hidden||!$('pauseScreen').hidden)){
  const overlay=won?$('finish'):$('pauseScreen'),buttons=[...overlay.querySelectorAll('button')],first=buttons[0],last=buttons[buttons.length-1];
  if(event.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===first){event.preventDefault();last.focus();}else if(!event.shiftKey&&document.activeElement===last){event.preventDefault();first.focus();}return;
 }
 if(event.code==='KeyR'&&!event.repeat){event.preventDefault();reset();return;}
 if((event.code==='KeyP'||event.code==='Escape')&&!event.repeat){event.preventDefault();togglePause();return;}
 if(!gameKeys.has(event.code)||paused||won)return;
 if(event.target instanceof HTMLButtonElement&&event.code==='Space')return;
 event.preventDefault();
 if(!keySet.has(event.code)&&['Space','ArrowUp','KeyW'].includes(event.code))jumpBuffer=.15;
 keySet.add(event.code);
});
window.addEventListener('keyup',event=>{
 const wasJump=isDown('jump');keySet.delete(event.code);
 if(wasJump&&!isDown('jump')&&player.vy< -170)player.vy*=.48;
 if(gameKeys.has(event.code))event.preventDefault();
});
for(const action of ['left','right','jump']){
 const button=$(action);
 button.addEventListener('pointerdown',event=>{
  event.preventDefault();if(paused||won)return;button.setPointerCapture(event.pointerId);pointerActions.set(event.pointerId,action);button.classList.add('held');
  if(action==='jump')jumpBuffer=.15;focusGame();
 });
 const release=event=>{
  const wasJump=isDown('jump');pointerActions.delete(event.pointerId);
  if(![...pointerActions.values()].includes(action))button.classList.remove('held');
  if(wasJump&&!isDown('jump')&&player.vy< -170)player.vy*=.48;
 };
 button.addEventListener('pointerup',release);button.addEventListener('pointercancel',release);button.addEventListener('lostpointercapture',release);
 // Native keyboard activation also gives touch controls a meaningful action.
 button.addEventListener('click',event=>{if(event.detail===0&&!paused&&!won){if(action==='jump')jumpBuffer=.15;else{player.vx=(action==='left'?-1:1)*250;player.x=clamp(player.x+(action==='left'?-16:16),4,3490);started=true;}}});
}
canvas.addEventListener('pointerdown',focusGame);
$('reset').addEventListener('click',reset);$('replay').addEventListener('click',reset);$('pauseReset').addEventListener('click',reset);
$('pause').addEventListener('click',()=>togglePause());$('touchPause').addEventListener('click',()=>togglePause());$('resume').addEventListener('click',()=>togglePause(false));
window.addEventListener('blur',()=>{clearInput();if(started&&!won&&!paused)togglePause(true);});
document.addEventListener('visibilitychange',()=>{if(document.hidden){clearInput();if(started&&!won&&!paused)togglePause(true);}lastTime=performance.now();accumulator=0;});
window.addEventListener('resize',()=>{try{resize();}catch(error){fail(error);}});
window.addEventListener('error',event=>fail(event.error||event.message));
window.addEventListener('unhandledrejection',event=>fail(event.reason));
window.addEventListener('unload',()=>{destroyed=true;cancelAnimationFrame(raf);clearInput();});
window.addEventListener('pagehide',()=>{cancelAnimationFrame(raf);clearInput();});
window.addEventListener('pageshow',event=>{if(event.persisted&&!destroyed){lastTime=performance.now();raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);}});
island.addEventListener('load',()=>{render();});
landscape.addEventListener('load',render);
resize();lastTime=performance.now();raf=requestAnimationFrame(frame);
} catch(error) {
 const panel=document.getElementById('error');panel.hidden=false;panel.textContent='Moonbound could not start: '+(error&&error.message?error.message:String(error));
}
</script></body></html>
